study type: Retrospective cohort study and follow-up survey
exposure: use of barbed suture for myometrial closure
cohort: 486 patients who underwent laparoscopic myomectomy with the use of barbed suture for myometrial closure between 2008 and 2016 at a single, large academic medical center
finding: Pregnancy outcomes after laparoscopic myomectomy with barbed suture are comparable with available literature on pregnancy outcomes with conventional smooth suture.
mod_finding: Of the 110 reported postoperative pregnancies, there were 60 live births (55%), 90% by means of cesarean section.
